test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given below, followed by four conclusions given in the options. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statement.

**Statement: ** Q > A ≥ Z > X < R ≤ H < M
solution:
Given Statement: Q > A ≥ Z > X Options:

(i) Z > X ≥ M → False (Z > X No relation can be established between X and M)

(ii) Q > M > H → False (Q > A ≥ Z > X No relation can be established between Q and M)

(iii) Q > X > A → False ​(Q > A ≥ Z > X It gives Q > A > X)

(iv) M > R > X → True (**X R > X**)

Here, Only Option iv is true.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
